acceptance: A change to scripts/worktree_lifecycle.sh, make/worktrees.mk or Makefile selects the tests that exercise them.
tests/unit/scripts/test_preflight_targets.py covers a Make path and a shell path selecting real tests.
No fixture-only name matching is added (see pr-preflight-workflow-selection-cost-20261101 on the same file).
context: Not on the batch loop's critical path: batch-member-check requires named tests for non-Python changes until this lands. Coordinate with pr-preflight-workflow-selection-cost-20261101, which changes the same file. Guardrails: deliver as an ordinary serial PR to develop (AGENTS.md: feature delivery cannot deliver the changes that make it possible); write only from a linked worktree made with make worktree-create and checked with make agent-write-preflight, never the primary clone; stage explicit paths, never git add -A; no explanatory comments or docstrings (COMMENT-POLICY-001, make comment-policy-check); heavy test runs only through lock-taking entry points, never BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK; never weaken hold labels, the unresolved-thread refusal, oracle-gate, duration or suite gates; add a changelog.d fragment (CHANGELOG_INTERNAL when nothing is user-visible); durable artifacts carry no session or phase labels; cited line numbers are leads, so re-read the code before editing; tests prove behaviour, never wiring or wording.
description: _project/scripts/preflight_targets.py skips non-Python paths before applying EXTRA_TEST_MAP (:279-281 versus :303), so a change to Makefile, make/*.mk or a worktree shell script selects only guard tests. Batch members routinely change these shared files. Apply the explicit map before the non-Python early return and map the worktree lifecycle scripts and Make files to the tests that exercise them.
